Kazakhstan
Consular help: Consular help will be provided by the Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Moscow, Russia.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens:
Regular passport YES Visa shall be issued in Vienna.
Regular biometric passport YES
Service/Official biometric passport NO
Diplomatic biometric passport NO
Foreign nationals entering the territory of the Republic of Kazakhstan must possess an Electronic Travel Authorization (ETA). Detailed information regarding this requirement is available on the “QazETA” digital platform.
Citizens of the Republic of Kazakhstan are required visas when entering, exiting or travelling through Bosnia and Herzegovina. Visa shall be issued in Moskva, Russia.Citizens of Kazahstan, holders of diplomatic and official passports, shall be exempt from the obligation to obtain a visa for entry, exit, transit and stay on the territory of Bosnia and Herzegovina up to 30 days.
